messages:
emma: Heads up — a bunch of PRs are hitting SAST failures in CI. The job logs show KMS decrypt denied errors. Anyone else seeing this?
sec-bot: [alert] nightly-ci/sast-run failed: kms.DecryptDenied for service-account:ci-runner@redwood. See logs: https://internal-logs/ci/17555 (automated)
raj: Yep, noticed this ~10m ago. Minimal error from the runner: ```ERROR: failed to fetch encrypted-keys: AccessDenied: You are not authorized to perform: cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt on projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdlc/cryptoKeys/ci-key```
maria: That matches a recent IAM change from yesterday — we scoped down a keystore maintainer role during the RBAC cleanup. CI SA might have lost the decrypt permission.
chris: If that's true we should avoid broad reverts. Short-term: grant a very narrow binding for the CI SA for one key only, with a TTL, then follow up with principle-of-least-privilege fix. Example gcloud: ```gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ci-key --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --project=redwood```
oncall: I can push an ephemeral grant now. Will also record the change in the keystore audit playbook. I need the failing PR numbers and the artifact IDs to attach to the incident.
emma: PRs: #4241, #4250, #4252. Artifacts under ci/sast/17555/*. Please attach before you modify policies. We want traceability.
sec-bot: Audit logs: recent admin activity on keystore shows IAM: setIamPolicy by alice@infra at 2025-06-10T18:12Z. log_id: /logs/keystore-authz.
raj: Can we confirm whether the decrypt permission was removed globally or just for the key used by CI? I saw two keys rotated last week.
maria: Looks like the rotation script removed a wildcard binding when it reapplied policy templates. It unintentionally dropped the ci-runner binding from the ci-key.
chris: Action plan: 1) oncall to grant ephemeral decrypt to ci-runner for ci-key (done with TTL). 2) create a tracked incident ticket with label security-sdlc and attach the failure artifacts + audit log entries. 3) update rotation script to preserve explicit per-key CI bindings or to use a service-account alias that the script knows not to touch.
oncall: Grant applied for 1h. Please verify CI rebuilds now. Logged change in audit: ticket INC-2025-789.
emma: Re-running checks... CI SAST passed on #4241 after the grant. Thanks.
raj: Confirmed for #4250 as well.
maria: For remediation, we should: - add an automated SAST failure classifier that flags kms.DecryptDenied and creates an auto-incident draft - add a pre-rotation check that validates a test CI job can decrypt before policy apply - store explicit allow for CI in a small managed policy the rotation ignores
chris: Also propose adding a short entry to the Secure SDLC playbook: detection -> immediate TTL grant -> attach artifacts -> owner creates follow-up PR to adjust rotation script. We can copy that to https://redwood.internal/playbooks/sdlc-kms (ops only).
oncall: Agree. I'll add playbook entry and link the INC ticket. Will also request a 1:1 with infra to review the rotation flow.
emma: Quick note — we should require that CI artifacts include the exact key resource name and the SA email in SAST run metadata. Makes triage much faster.
sec-bot: Suggestion: add a new alert rule that groups repeated SAST failures with the same kms error into a single incident to reduce noise.
maria: I'll open a follow-up RFC for rotation script changes and the SAST classifier. Assigning owners: maria (rotation script), raj (SAST classifier), chris (playbook update).
emma: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates in INC-2025-789 and reference this thread for context. :thumbsup:
chris: One more follow-up, let's add a checklist item to the pre-merge security gate to fail with a clear reason when decrypt errors occur and link to the playbook. Low effort, big signal.
oncall: Done — brief note added to the gate config. Will monitor for recurrence.
sec-bot: closing automated alert for now (incident linked INC-2025-789)
emma: Closing the loop — will review postmortem draft tomorrow and publish recommended guardrails.
raj: Thanks — nice quick triage.
maria: Good catch, team.
chris: Great job.
